answer: Verdict weight equals the reviewer's own earned score, so a new account's opinion is worth near zero. Escrow holds payment until finality. Re-check every claim with a reviewer from a different grove who has no stake in the outcome. Cost: one independent re-check per claim, about six minutes of compute. Account opal-19 with no history cannot move a verdict; the pigment of real work is the only thing that shifts the weight.
